<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/database_node_preview_record/{project_guid}/{workflow_guid}/{node_guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Runs the node's poll for one record and reads it as the node would,
returning the message it would send. Reads only: the record's status is
left as it is, so the node still sends it.
